bayts.text: answer me, purify my heart and illumine it, (making it) wide, able to retain all the texts.
And grant me perpetual protection, (making me) safe from harm and from temptations.
Lord, hasten the fulfilment of my needs, and soon gladden, through me, my mosques and my contemporaries.
Lord, lead me and grant me the loftiest of requests, and make this Book my companion.
And bear witness for me that I have cast off for good what I have sold, and make following in the footsteps of him whose intercession is accepted my religion.
Bless him unceasingly, Lord, and grant him peace, together with the notables through whom my softening appeared.
Lord, grant me in this world and the Other to be a worshipper and a servant, with the best guardianship.
Yours is Dāru s-Salām (Darou Salam), Lord, and Ṭūbā (Touba): grant me, Lord, in both an abiding dwelling.
And tame for me, O Lord, land and sea, while I abide in my places of gratitude, furnished with fortresses.
And make contentment in You endure for me, my Lord, (making me) rightly guided and a guide, with a guarded secret.
And bring me my desires without toil, (making me) a worshipper and a servant with the best religion.
And through me benefit, in this world and the Other, my household, (making me) the rescuer of every beggar and debtor.
And gladden the learned with my knowledge, and the ignorant too; and tame my time for me.
And gladden all who learn, and through me guard them all from errors of speech.
And ever gladden the orphans through me; through me make them forget their fathers at all times.
Lord, increase me in knowledge (Qurʾān 20:114) and increase me in deeds, O Generous One toward Whom my longing is unceasing.
Grant me unveiling, upright and penitent, in the Clear Book, root of the disciplines.
Answer my supplication, be gentle with me and bring me more than I sought with lament and moaning.
And convey from You, Lord, the best blessing, with peace, to the Intercessor, the Trustworthy.
And grant me felicity, give abundance, and through him inscribe me among the people of the right hand.
And shield me from harm and trials, tame the enemies for me and make my help everlasting.
And spare me the whole host of enemies, and grant me refuge in You from Iblīs, the stoned, the accursed.
And illumine my heart with an opening, and expand for me, Lord, my breast (Qurʾān 20:25) with the outpouring of flowing spring water.
And bring me my desires perpetually, O Helper Who never ceases to be the best of helpers.
And guide me today, O my God, and make my work pure like the flowing of springs.
And erase my faults from me, and tame for me for ever every lying denier.
And increase the best of creatures in blessing and peace, and ever increase my shelter.
Increase my guarding against all Your prohibitions, and protect me from the harm of every miserly envier.
And perfect my creed, my knowledge and my deeds, and raise them all today, O my Helper.
